'''Big Rampage at the Safari Zone!?''' (Japanese: '''サファリゾーンで大暴れ！？''' ''Big Rampage at the Safari Zone!?'') is the fourteenth chapter of the [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] manga. It was first published in the May 1997 issue of CoroCoro Comic, on April 15th, 1997.
